employees.evidence: Our skilled workforce is comprised of individuals drawn from a broad cross section of the global communities we serve.

dei.evidence: We know a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture matters to our clients.

environment.evidence: New fuel-cell system and six-acre solar panel field at Morgan Stanley's Westchester campus help reduce the firm's carbon footprint.

community.evidence: The Firm is dedicated to making a positive contribution to society through our core business activities, employment practices, operations and philanthropic giving.

shareholders.evidence: We work to maximize capital to build a more sustainable future.

integrity.evidence: Leadership at Morgan Stanley isn't just about good corporate governance.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, mission-led framing with absolute language ('dedicated', 'believe'). Community and sustainability lead, addressed through a mix of Firm-voice and first-person 'we'. Much of the page is historical milestones and statistics, which are business description rather than stated values. Customers, safety and innovation are largely absent.
